item.title: Green Man Unveils Lineup for 2026 Edition
item.description: Wilco, Mogwai, Four Tet and Wolf Alice will headline this year's festival Photo by Patrick Gunning Green Man has shared the full lineup for its 2026 edition. This year's festival, taking place at its usual Bannau Brycheiniog National Park home, will be headlined by Wilco, Mogwai, Four Tet and Wolf Alice. item.title: Seefeel Reveal First New Album in 15 Years
item.description: Sol.Hz is described as the group's 'dub' album Photo by Jeff Pitcher Seefeel are set to release their first new album in 15 years, titled Sol.Hz. Comprised of nine tracks, the LP is described in a press release as the group's 'dub' album, and follows on from 2024's mini-album Squared Roots. item.description: Ragger Euphonic Sounds Los Angeles duo play ragtime with Gameboy sounds, at once comic and oddly disquieting Euphonic Sounds by Ragger Ragger’s Euphonic Sounds is a temporal anomaly tripping over itself and tumbling out your speakers. item.title: Aldous Harding Details New Album, ‘Train On The Island’
item.description: 4AD will release the LP in May Photo by Kate Ellen Meakin Aldous Harding has a new album on the way, titled Train On The Island. item.title: Carla dal Forno to Release New Album, ‘Confession’
item.description: The artist's first album in almost four years was recorded in a partially abandoned hospital Carla dal Forno has a new album on the way, titled Confession. item.title: Justin K. Broadrick Halts Godflesh Live Shows Following Abdominal Surgery
item.description: He will, however, continue to perform as JK Flesh and jesu following his recovery as the two projects don't require screaming or shouting Justin K. Broadrick will no longer perform live as Godflesh. The UK artist has been forced to call time on the project as a live entity after undergoing abdominal surgery three weeks ago to treat an inguinal hernia that, he said on Instagram, was "close to an emergency".
